IGUI_WoodCutter_OutlineRangeHelp: Radius around the player in tiles. Default: 5. 0 disables tree outlines.
IGUI_WoodCutter_AlwaysShowHelp: Outdoors on foot, even without an axe or aiming. Green targets require aiming with an axe in both hands. Hidden indoors and in vehicles. Off by default.
IGUI_WoodCutter_ShowInVehicleHelp: Gray outlines only while in a vehicle, including passengers and parked vehicles. Hidden indoors. Off by default.
